notes: Be An Anchor site directs people to a Binti online application. DCYF lists Adoption Rhode Island and private agencies as recruitment partners; whether any acts as a contracted front door was not confirmed.

name: Heartfelt Calling
notes: DSS calls it its partner agency that manages enquiries about foster home licensing or adoption approval; takes enquiries by phone or online application; staff can complete an initial application by phone. Recruitment plan 2020-2024 describes a DSS contract (https://dss.sc.gov:443/media/2444/foster-and-adoptive-parent-recruitment-plan-2020-2024-final.pdf). Website named as heartfeltcalling.org but that URL did not appear in result links.

name: South Carolina DSS prospective foster parents
operator: South Carolina Department of Social Services
notes: DSS points enquirers to its partner Heartfelt Calling (see us-sc-heartfelt-calling).

name: South Dakota DSS foster care
operator: South Dakota Department of Social Services
notes: Families may also go through a local CPS office or a private placement agency.

name: Stronger Families Together
operator: South Dakota Department of Social Services, with South Dakota Kids Belong
notes: Statewide recruitment campaign launched May 2021. Page says the first step is to contact the Inquiry Coordinator. The listed enquiry email is on a Lutheran Social Services of South Dakota domain; unclear whether LSS runs the enquiry line under contract, so contracted is recorded as no pending check. Same pages also appear under fosterone.sd.gov.

name: TN Fosters (Tennessee DCS foster parent inquiry)
stated_response_time: DCS will call within five business days
notes: Enquirers submit the Inquiry Form for Potential Foster Parents or leave a message on the DCS inquiry line; then an information meeting and PATH training. Response promise taken from search summary of DCS pages; exact page holding it not confirmed. No regional contracted front doors found for Tennessee.

name: Texas DFPS foster and adoption information meetings
operator: Texas Department of Family and Protective Services
coverage: Statewide; in Community-Based Care regions meetings are run by the contractor
notes: Search summary says attending an information meeting is a required first step; some supporting snippets came from archived pages. Information meetings page lists region-by-region recruitment contacts: https://dfps.texas.gov/Adoption_and_Foster_Care/Get_Started/Information_Meetings/

name: 2INgage (Region 2)
notes: DFPS page says 2INgage handles foster care and adoption information meetings for all Region 2 counties. Stage III; contract ends May 2028 with reprocurement under way (https://www.dfps.texas.gov/CBC/documents/reports/2025-31-12-OCBCT_Quarterly_Report.pdf). Sector assumed non-profit; unverified. Website URL not found.

name: 4Kids4Families (Region 4)
notes: DFPS says 4Kids4Families handles foster care and adoption information meetings for all Region 4 counties; runs a virtual Foster Care 101 session. Moved to Stage III on 1 March 2026. Sector assumed non-profit; unverified. Website URL not found.

name: Belong (Region 8A)
notes: Entered Stage I August 2025 and Stage II on 1 March 2026. Coverage as Bexar County is inferred from 8B covering the 27 counties around Bexar; unverified. Website URL not found.

name: Belong (Region 8B)
coverage: Region 8B, South Central and Hill Country, 27 counties around Bexar County
notes: SSCC since April 2022; June 2026 report lists Stage II. Website URL not found.

name: EMPOWER (Region 3E)
notes: Court appointed a receiver for EMPOWER's operations on 18 March 2026; EMPOWER says it retains its state contract. June 2026 DFPS report lists Stage II, contract to 31 Oct 2028. Unclear who answers foster enquiries during receivership. Sector assumed non-profit; unverified.

name: Our Community Our Kids (Region 3W)
coverage: Region 3W, Metroplex West: Cooke, Denton, Erath, Hood, Johnson, Palo Pinto, Parker, Somervell, Tarrant and Wise counties
notes: DFPS says OCOK handles foster care and adoption information meetings for Region 3W. Formerly called Region 3B. Stage III. Website given as oc-ok.org in one source and ourcommunity-ourkids.org in another; neither URL appeared in result links.

name: Saint Francis Community Services in Texas (Region 1)
operator: Saint Francis Community Services in Texas, Inc.
notes: SSCC under Community-Based Care; June 2026 DFPS quarterly report lists Stage III, contract term to 2029. Sector assumed non-profit; unverified. Website URL not found.

name: Texans Together (Regions 6A and 6B)
coverage: Regions 6A and 6B, Houston area including Harris County
notes: Entered Stage I on 1 May 2026. Unclear whether Texans Together yet takes foster enquiries: DFPS information meetings page still lists DFPS recruitment staff for Region 6, and the Greater Houston Permanency Collaborative hosts information sessions.

name: Texas Family Care Network (Region 5)
coverage: Region 5, Deep East Texas, 15 counties around Beaumont
notes: DFPS says TFCN handles foster care and adoption information meetings for all Region 5 counties. Moved to Stage III on 1 March 2026; contract term to 31 March 2028. Award date differs by source (15 March or 1 April 2023).

name: Utah DCFS foster care
operator: Utah Department of Health and Human Services, Division of Child and Family Services
notes: DCFS's own foster page URL not found; recruitment is contracted to Utah Foster Care (see us-ut-utah-foster-care).

name: Utah Foster Care
notes: DCFS contracts Utah Foster Care to recruit, train and retain foster families for levels 1 to 3 of care. Statewide, so level recorded as state. Website link is a short form URL from search results; current contract terms not checked.

name: Virginia's Faster Families Highway
coverage: Statewide; connects enquirers with local departments
notes: Enquirers create an account and go through a six-step readiness process; the site links them to local departments of social services. Also appears under dss.virginia.gov/fosterVA.

name: Vermont DCF Family Services Division foster care
operator: Vermont Department for Children and Families, Family Services Division
notes: No single current official enquiry line found; website is a DCF leaflet. DCF has promoted RaiseAChild.org information sessions; unclear whether that is a contracted arrangement.

name: Washington DCYF foster parenting
operator: Washington State Department of Children, Youth, and Families
notes: Page offers a foster parent inquiry form or an inquiry phone line, and monthly online information sessions on the first Tuesday. Inquiry form URL not found. A contracted programme with Olive Crest (Fostering Together) was mentioned in an older secondary source; current status unclear, so no row added.

name: Port Gamble S'Klallam Tribe Children and Family Services
coverage: Port Gamble S'Klallam Tribe, Kitsap County, WA
notes: selection: iv-e. Named on the Children's Bureau page Tribes with Approved Title IV-E Plans (https://acf.gov/cb/grant-funding/tribes-approved-title-iv-e-plans) per search snippet; the page could not be opened and may be out of date, and the page says some listed tribes have not moved to direct implementation. Snippets describe tribal foster home licensing, respite and foster parent training. Some licensed homes are off the reservation per a news report (https://ictnews.org/?p=93316).

name: South Puget Intertribal Planning Agency
coverage: Member tribes of the consortium in south Puget Sound, WA
notes: selection: iv-e. Named on the Children's Bureau page Tribes with Approved Title IV-E Plans (https://acf.gov/cb/grant-funding/tribes-approved-title-iv-e-plans) per search snippet; the page could not be opened and may be out of date, and the page says some listed tribes have not moved to direct implementation. Tribal consortium based in Shelton, WA. Listed on a Washington DCYF child placing agency contact list (source). No SPIPA foster care page turned up in search; website left blank. Unclear whether SPIPA licenses homes itself or certifies them to DCYF.

name: Wisconsin DCF become a foster parent
operator: Wisconsin Department of Children and Families
coverage: Statewide; directs enquirers to their county foster care coordinator
notes: DCF advises contacting the foster care coordinator in the county where you live. The statewide Wisconsin Family Connections Center (Coalition for Children, Youth & Families) supports families with out-of-home care involvement; not recorded as a front door.

name: Children's Wisconsin foster care (Milwaukee)
coverage: Milwaukee County area (within one hour of Milwaukee)
notes: DCF says DMCPS has two agencies that recruit, license and support foster parents. Children's Wisconsin and Wellpoint Care Network are named in results but it is unclear whether these are the two DMCPS-contracted licensing agencies.

name: Wellpoint Care Network foster care (Milwaukee)
notes: DMCPS works with Wellpoint Care Network among other providers. Unclear whether Wellpoint is one of the two agencies contracted to license foster homes for DMCPS; check before relying on this row.

name: Mission West Virginia
notes: Described as the first point of contact for people interested in fostering in West Virginia; does not certify families but helps choose an agency. Unclear whether this is under a formal state contract; contracted recorded as yes because BSS routes its inquiry form through Mission WV. Main domain given as missionwv.org; result link was a squarespace address.

name: We Foster West Virginia campaign
operator: West Virginia Department of Human Services, with Aetna Better Health of West Virginia, Mission West Virginia and ten foster care agencies
notes: Statewide recruitment campaign launched March 2024, four months long; Mission WV handled enquiries as hub. Campaign site named as wefosterwv.org but that URL did not appear in result links. Unclear whether still running.

name: West Virginia BSS foster homes
operator: West Virginia Department of Human Services, Bureau for Social Services
notes: Page says to complete the online Foster Parent Inquiry Form or contact Mission WV. See state note on conflicting accounts of whether the state still certifies non-kin foster homes.

name: Wyoming DFS foster care
coverage: Statewide, through local foster care coordinators
notes: A foster care contact-us thank-you page exists (https://dfs.wyo.gov/foster-care-contact-us-thank-you/), suggesting an online contact form; form URL not found.
